description: A festival operations director must approve the operating plan for an immersive sound-and-light installation before the public opening, including visitor flow, capture rules, accessibility sessions, staffing, and required production records.

shared_context.S1: The festival plans to open the immersive installation Echo Chamber to the public on Saturday.
shared_context.S2: Mara has final authority to approve the installation's operating plan.
shared_context.S3: The current draft plan allows 12 visitors per session, permits visitor photography, schedules one general admission queue, and assigns one floor attendant.
shared_context.S4: The festival's normal opening procedure is a sign-off round in which technical, rights, accessibility, and risk leads each report any confirmed requirement before Mara approves the public operating plan.
shared_context.S5: The installation occupies one enclosed gallery and uses directional speakers, projection, and a timed visitor route.

PF1.text: Devon completed a thermal and equipment-reset test after yesterday's rehearsal: Echo Chamber may admit no more than 8 visitors per session and requires a 15-minute reset between sessions. The results are in Devon's test notebook but have not yet been entered in the festival operations sheet.

PF2.text: Leila reviewed the artist's executed sound-and-image license this morning: visitor photography, audio recording, and video recording are all prohibited, and the gallery must display the credit exactly as 'Echo Chamber by Nia Okafor'. Leila has not yet replaced the draft language in the visitor-facing materials.

PF3.text: Jonah confirmed with the access consultant after the rehearsal that the installation must offer two low-sensory sessions daily, at exactly 2:00 PM and 6:00 PM, with each session lasting 20 minutes. The consultant's confirmation arrived after the draft schedule was circulated and is not yet on the public timetable.

PF4.text: Sofia received the insurer's signed endorsement today: every public session requires 2 trained floor attendants and a signed participant waiver before entry. Sofia has the endorsement in the risk file, but the staffing roster and ticketing instructions still reflect the draft plan.

acceptance_conditions: The installation must admit exactly 8 visitors per session.
The installation must use a 15-minute reset between sessions.
All visitor photography, audio recording, and video recording must be prohibited.
The gallery credit must use the exact wording 'Echo Chamber by Nia Okafor'.
Low-sensory sessions must occur exactly at 2:00 PM and 6:00 PM.
Each low-sensory session must last exactly 20 minutes.
Every public session must have exactly 2 trained floor attendants.
A signed participant waiver must be required before entry.
The operating plan must contain commitments updating the visitor-flow, rights, accessibility, and risk records.

content_checks.C3: decisions['capture_policy'] in ['No visitor photography, audio recording, or video recording', 'No photography, audio recording, or video recording permitted inside Echo Chamber', 'no photography, audio recording, or video recording', 'no visitor photography, audio recording, or video recording']

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The tested equipment limit changes the draft from 12 visitors and an unspecified reset to exactly 8 visitors and a 15-minute reset, requiring the visitor-flow record to be updated.
The executed license changes the draft capture policy to a complete prohibition and changes the gallery credit to exactly 'Echo Chamber by Nia Okafor', requiring the rights materials to be updated.
The consultant confirmation changes the draft timetable by adding low-sensory sessions exactly at 2:00 PM and 6:00 PM, each lasting 20 minutes, requiring the accessibility timetable to be updated.

The insurer's endorsement changes staffing from one to exactly 2 floor attendants and changes entry from no stated waiver to a required signed participant waiver, requiring the risk and ticketing records to be updated.
